digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud adapter and backend characterization test suite
propositions: Characterization test suite must pin exact output values of all Jira adapter units before they are extracted and moved to shared modules, to prevent silent mapping regressions during refactoring
Current contract test suite is vendor-neutral and cannot detect Jira-specific mapping changes, so golden-value assertions are required as extraction oracle
Value maps for status and priority exist in multiple independent copies that have already drifted, creating risk of inconsistency between adapter copies and ACLI copy
Sanitizers must be pinned at, below, and above their limits including the deliberate 254-vs-255 off-by-one boundary on both sides
Identity convention parsing must preserve both colon and legacy hyphen forms to avoid breaking existing ticket identifiers
Probe response classification must distinguish all branches including archived/moved and error status codes with exact detail dicts
